title: Dialz: A Python Toolkit for Steering Vectors

bias_targets.methodology: Generating model responses to prompts designed to elicit racial stereotypes and evaluating the outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) on a 1-10 stereotypicality scale, comparing baseline models to models modified with steering vectors.
